concerns.text: T023a implements a conditional GP (only if Moran's I > 0.15), contradicting Plan.md Summary and Constitution Principle VII which mandate a 'mandatory a priori' GP random effect. This silently weakens FR-004's requirement for a priori spatial autocorrelation handling.

Tasks T030/T031 explicitly reject 'geomstats' and 'Fréchet mean' in favor of 'Discrete Centroid Trajectory Analysis' (arithmetic mean in UTM). This violates FR-006 and US-3 which mandate 'Riemannian manifold' trajectory statistics. The plan's 'Complexity Tracking' justifies this, but the task list executes a methodological deviation without a ratified spec amendment.

T025b applies permutation tests to 'shift vectors' (spatial data), whereas FR-005 explicitly mandates permutation tests on 'species-climate coefficients'. This is a semantic weakening of the statistical requirement, applying the test to the wrong metric.

T025b depends on T053 which proposes a 'dynamic reduction strategy' for shuffles if time limits are exceeded. FR-005 mandates 'exactly 10,000' shuffles. Allowing a reduction strategy without a ratified spec amendment violates the explicit count requirement.

T005c1 (Download Daymet) executes the data substitution before T005c4b (Update Spec Text) completes. This creates a circular dependency where the implementation proceeds on a deviation that the spec has not yet formally ratified, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle during execution.

T005c1b attempts to fetch NOAA/PRISM data as a 'spec compliance' measure despite the Plan explicitly discarding it in favor of Daymet. This wastes CI resources and contradicts the Plan's 'Data Access Strategy', introducing a silent fallback path not authorized by the ratified spec.
